title: Hybrid headless + console-tethered onboarding illustrations for Private/VPC
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and produce a set of UX assets and product screenshots to support a hybrid Private/VPC onboarding flow that works both headless (operator-focused CLI) and tethered to the Redwood Console. Deliverables include: a 6-step flow diagram for 'Headless + Tethered' install, an interactive upgrade-preview modal visual, a certificate rotation microcopy set, a drift-detection illustration, annotated install-step screenshots for docs, and accessibility-ready PNG/SVG exports. The goal is to reduce operator support requests by clarifying the secure key exchange and upgrade rollback affordances in the first-run and upgrade journeys.
acceptance_criteria: Flow diagram exported as Figma frames and flattened PNG/SVGs for docs
Upgrade-preview modal visual and two alternative CTA states (canary/rollback) reviewed and approved
Annotated screenshots for CLI headless steps and Console tethering included with microcopy and callouts
Security microcopy covering ephemeral key exchange and certificate rotation reviewed by Security
Accessibility check: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary CTAs; alt text drafted for all illustrations
Handoff package (Figma link, export presets, PNG/SVG assets, source component names) uploaded to Confluence
comments: 2026-03-03 - Ava M: Kickoff with PM and Eng. Align on scope: support both headless CLI + Console tethering. Need to show 'operator mode' vs 'console-tethered' explicitly.

2026-03-05 - Liam C: Initial sketches uploaded to Figma. Two visual directions: 'pipeline' (linear steps) and 'hub-and-spoke' (Console as central orchestrator). Preference from PM for pipeline for docs clarity.
2026-03-07 - Priya Rao (Security): Security review requested. Highlight ephemeral key exchange and KMS hookup. Added checklist items about not showing real keys and emphasizing one-time tokens.

2026-03-08 - Design Review: Feedback to reduce illustrative detail on network topology; use simplified icons for NAT, firewall, and private endpoints. Add 'drift detection' badge visual for upgrade flow.
2026-03-09 - UX Writer (Noah G): Microcopy suggestions for upgrade modal: change 'Force rollback' to 'Revert to last stable' and add concise reason field for audit logs.
2026-03-10 - Eng (Maya S): Note on feasibility: console-initiated tether requires a short-lived bootstrap agent; add a step showing agent ephemeral token exchange and 'wait for heartbeat' state.

2026-03-11 - Accessibility (Ravi K): Color adjustments made: primary CTA updated to meet contrast. Added alt-text drafts for all major diagrams. Suggest simplified animation for onboarding micro-interactions.
2026-03-12 - Liam C: Submitted final Figma frames and export package to Confluence. Requesting PM approval for inclusion in 2026.03 console release notes.
notes: Design choices: keep network illustrations abstract (no vendor logos), focus on operator confidence during key exchange and upgrades. Provide two screenshot sets: lightweight for quickstart docs and annotated for runbook. Use 'lean-operator' color palette for CLI screens and 'brand' palette for Console. Prepare a short 6-frame GIF demonstrating tether flow for the marketing quickstart page.
